mistake_reason: At step 8, WebSurfer had the transcript view open and observed the specific numeric phrase immediately following the dinosaur visuals ("one hundred million"), but withheld the exact digits, reporting only a vague summary that it was "a large rounded figure in the tens of millions." This intentional omission of the precise number (100,000,000) prevented the team from converging on the correct answer and led the orchestrator to adopt a conventional but incorrect figure (65,000,000). This matches FM-2.4 Information Withholding: the agent concealed critical data that would have altered the team's decision.
